errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the horizontal axis shows the countries. The horizontal axis displays the percentage values, while the vertical axis lists the countries.
The countries are not sorted alphabetically. The bars are sorted in descending order based on their corresponding values, from highest (Netherlands) to lowest (Ireland).
The description incorrectly states that the vertical axis measures the percentage. The vertical axis lists the countries, while the horizontal axis measures the percentage.
The highest value of 21.2 corresponds to the Netherlands (Нидерландия), not Slovakia (Словакия). Slovakia's value is 19.2.
